sql.value: select t.STAFF_ID,t.STAFF_CODE,t.STAFF_NAME,t.ORGAN_ID,t.SEX_TYPE,t.ENTRY_DATE from sqltoy_staff_info t where t.STATUS=1 #[and t.ORGAN_ID in (:organIds)] #[and t.STAFF_NAME like :staffName] #[and t.ENTRY_DATE>=:beginDate] #[and t.ENTRY_DATE<=:endDate]

select t1.*,t2.ORGAN_NAME from @fast( select t.STAFF_ID,t.STAFF_CODE,t.STAFF_NAME,t.ORGAN_ID,t.ENTRY_DATE from sqltoy_staff_info t where t.STATUS=1 #[and t.STAFF_NAME like :staffName] order by t.ENTRY_DATE desc ) t1 left join sqltoy_organ_info t2 on t1.ORGAN_ID=t2.ORGAN_ID
select t.STAFF_ID,t.STAFF_NAME,t.ORGAN_ID,t.ORGAN_ID organName,t.SEX_TYPE,t.SEX_TYPE sexTypeName from sqltoy_staff_info t where t.STATUS=1 #[and t.STAFF_NAME like :staffName]
select nvl(sum(t.TOTAL_AMT),0) total_amt from lesson_device_order t where t.STATUS=1
select 'HQ' organ_id,'Head Office' organ_name @virtualTable() union all select t.ORGAN_ID,t.ORGAN_NAME from sqltoy_organ_info t
